run_pybullet_gui_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads multiple URDF robot models and steps the physics loop
load_urdf_robot_model: load a URDF robot model into the pybullet simulation at a specified position in 3D space
get_joint_info: get joint information for each joint of a loaded URDF robot body using getJointInfo
capture_segmentation_mask_image: capture a camera image with the ER_SEGMENTATION_MASK_OBJECT_AND_LINKINDEX flag to extract object UIDs and link indices from pixels
read_keyboard_events: read keyboard events in the pybullet GUI loop to toggle verbose output and segmentation mask flags
